```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# install.packages("reticulate")
library(reticulate)
use_condaenv("r-reticulate", required = TRUE)
py_config()
```

# Datasets

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_fb    <- readr::read_rds(here::here("_processed_data", "df_fb_clean.rds"))
df_insta <- readr::read_rds(here::here("_processed_data", "df_insta_clean.rds"))
df_X     <- readr::read_rds(here::here("_processed_data", "df_X_clean.rds"))
```


```{r}
reticulate::py_install("leia-br", pip = TRUE) 
# Note: 'leia-br' is the distribution name for the Brazilian Portuguese VADER
```
```{r}
library(reticulate)
use_condaenv("r-reticulate", required = TRUE)

# Fallback if leia_br isn't found
leia <- import("leia")
analyzer <- leia$SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()

# Test it
result <- analyzer$polarity_scores("Isso é uma farsa e uma vergonha!")
print(result)
```

```{r}
# Define the extraction function
get_compound <- function(text) {
  # Handle NA, empty strings, or non-character data
  if (is.na(text) || nchar(trimws(as.character(text))) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  scores <- analyzer$polarity_scores(as.character(text))
  return(scores$compound)
}
```

### FB
```{r}
df_fb$compound_sentiment <- vapply(
  df_fb$text_combined,
  get_compound,
  FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)
)
```

*Variable: negative polarity + intensity.*
```{r}
library(dplyr)

df_fb <- df_fb %>%
  mutate(
    negative_intensity = ifelse(compound_sentiment < 0, 
                                abs(compound_sentiment), 
                                0)
  )
```
